artifactPaths use the ALK result/review templates under the package evidence root.
The plan explicitly forbids HTTPTransport imports from the higher api layer and keeps transport errors transport-neutral.
Avatar TypeScript adapters are owned so fileUrl construction requires no main.ts side effect and preserves src/avatar caller props.
The worker is required to ignore populated env files while allowing .env.example, .env.development and .env.own.example.
Backend, Router/Store/Block, module migration, architecture guard, legacy deletion, CI and production promotion remain outside the package.
